propositions: A one-time history-strip script using stock Git plumbing must be built as a committed operational script and proven on a scratch unfiltered clone before any remote publication.

The rewrite pipeline must preserve all commits, merge commits, and DAG topology while removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ from every historical revision, with the final tree byte-identical to the old tree after dynamic re-add.
The script must reject partial clones (blob:none) and verify absence of the protected tag refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z locally while leaving source remote refs unchanged.
The rewritten branch must have pack size at most 150 MB and must produce a fresh clone where old-tip is not an ancestor of new-tip after a representative post-rewrite writer push.
The binary fast-export stream filter must parse data blocks by byte length rather than line-based filtering to handle commit messages that begin with M or D.
All graph, tree, history-removal, and pack-size assertions must complete before the script produces its final success result, with no remote push operations ever invoked.
